exposure: Combined Spinal Epidural Anaesthesia with Epidural Volume Extension of Saline (CSE + saline)
combined Spinal Epidural Anaesthesia alone (CSE standard dose)
cohort: 100 individuals undergoing elective lower-limb orthopaedic procedures in the supine position
finding: A minimal dose of bupivacaine combined with fentanyl and normal saline results in rapid sensory and motor blockade, high sensory block, and shorter two-segment regression compared to standard CSE alone.
